name: confirm_live_identity
description: Unlock approved returning-user memory only after Amy has completed a useful warm exchange, asked for the visitor's preferred name, and separately received explicit permission to check for notes from a previous conversation. Never ask for or submit an email address for memory access; the application privately verifies the session-bound website check-in identity. After success, follow the returned instruction: briefly identify two or three distinctive earlier-session facts, distinguish them from today's statements, and ask whether they are still current.

preferredName.description: The preferred name the visitor stated during this live conversation.

memoryAccessConfirmed.description: True only after the visitor explicitly agrees that Amy may check for approved notes from a previous conversation.
